{"doc_id": "org-chart", "start_line": 22, "end_line": 77, "total_lines": 123, "text": "The six executives and the Chief of Staff are counted separately from the teams below: 7 people.

## Engineering

Led by Tomas Lindqvist, CTO. Headcount: 93.

| Team | Manager | Title | Headcount | Main site |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Platform | Dmitri Volkov | Director of Platform Engineering | 24 | Oakland |
| Forecasting and Data Science | Lila Haddad | Director of Forecasting | 14 | Oakland |
| Apps | Wei Zhang | Engineering Manager, Apps | 13 | Oakland and Rotterdam |
| Firmware | Nadia Ferreira | Firmware Engineering Manager | 11 | Boulder |
| Hardware Engineering | Owen Castellanos | Director of Hardware Engineering | 16 | Boulder |
| Site Reliability Engineering | Grace Nwosu | Director of Site Reliability Engineering | 9 | Oakland |
| Security | Ibrahim Saleh | Chief Information Security Officer | 6 | Oakland |

What each team does:

- **Platform** builds the GridLens backend: ingestion, storage, and the public API. Arjun Mehta, Staff Engineer, owns the Ingestion API. Katya Petrova, Senior Engineer, leads the storage work.
- **Forecasting and Data Science** builds the forecasting models and the analytics behind the Loss Analytics and Outage Detection modules. Jonas Weber, Senior Data Scientist, is the technical lead for Project Kestrel.
- **Apps** builds the GridLens web application and FieldKit, the technician companion application for phones and tablets that installers use on site.
- **Firmware** builds EmberOS, the firmware for the Meridian M4 and the Pulse S2. Sam Okonkwo, Senior Firmware Engineer, leads over-the-air updates. Mei-Ling Chou, Firmware Engineer, leads firmware for Project Heron.
- **Hardware Engineering** designs and tests the devices and runs the Boulder lab.
- **Site Reliability Engineering** runs the cloud infrastructure and the incident process. Hiro Matsuda is the on-call coordinator.
- **Security** protects company and customer data and runs the security program.

## Product

Led by Aiko Tanabe, VP Product. Headcount: 14.

| Team | Manager | Title | Headcount | Main site |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Product Management | Daniel Osei | Group Product Manager | 8 | Oakland |
| Design | Sofia Marchetti | Head of Design | 6 | Oakland |

Elena Vasquez is the product manager for GridLens forecasting and for Project Kestrel. Rohan Kapoor is the product manager for devices and for Project Heron.

## Revenue

Led by Renee Bouchard, Chief Revenue Officer. Headcount: 53.

| Team | Manager | Title | Headcount | Main site |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sales | Jamal Whitfield | VP Sales | 18 | Oakland and Rotterdam |
| Customer Success | Hannah Kowalski | Director of Customer Success | 15 | Oakland and Rotterdam |
| Field Operations | Luis Ortega | Director of Field Operations | 12 | Boulder |
| Marketing | Callum Reid | Head of Marketing | 8 | Oakland |

Bridget O'Malley is an Account Executive covering cooperatives in the Midwest. Yusuf Demir is a Customer Success Manager for municipal utilities. Tyrone Banks is the Lead Field Technician.

## Finance and Administration

Led by Helen Okafor, CFO. Headcount: 17.

|---|---|---|---|---|"}
